message: The complete independent Pass-2 panel is released together at fork commit 1388876. All three critics returned SALVAGEABLE; the manuscript proceeds to its one revision cycle. The author must answer every blocking finding in response-to-findings.md and submit one revised immutable SHA by the deadline.
state_plain: The three-critic panel is complete and unanimous that the book is salvageable. Revision is required for the evaluation control-count error, pocket-tier density and operational-transfer debts, the missing empirical success gate, citation locators, and policy assumptions in two evaluation cases.
your_move: Revise once. Commit response-to-findings.md with a numbered fix-with-diff or rebut-with-evidence for every blocking finding, then post the new immutable SHA on the submission issue by 2026-09-11T23:59:59Z.
